request.objective: Compare the explicitly selected JFK to LAX route across January-March and May 2025. Include observed cohort counts, delay rates, nominal Wilson intervals and their limitations. Use route history evidence; do not substitute monthly totals or simulation.

limitations: Currently imported historical US domestic rows; carriers combined; April excluded.
Intervals treat observations as independent binomial trials; shared weather/operations can violate that assumption.
No correction for repeated route searches or causal/significance claim; displayed difference is descriptive.
No cluster assignment, forecast, operational recommendation or UAE validation.

observation.evidence_text:
Historical US route JFK to LAX; reporting carriers are combined.
January-March 2025: 2325 source flights, 2303 completed observed arrivals, 384 arrival delays of at least 15 minutes; observed delay rate 16.6739%, nominal 95% Wilson interval 15.2073% to 18.2515%.
May 2025: 874 source flights, 872 completed observed arrivals, 164 arrival delays of at least 15 minutes; observed delay rate 18.8073%, nominal 95% Wilson interval 16.3526% to 21.5357%.
Wilson intervals assume independent binomial observations; shared weather and operations can violate this assumption.
These are descriptive historical counts and rates, not forecasts, cluster assignments, significance tests, causal findings or UAE validation.
